how_to_apply: Visit the official NRLM Karnataka Job Portal at jobsksrlps.karnataka.gov.in.
Click Register to create a free account, or Sign In if you already have one.
Browse the job listing and open the Details page of the post you wish to apply for.
Review the eligibility, qualification, and experience criteria for that specific post and taluka.
Click Sign In to Apply (or Apply) and complete the online application before the closing date.
important_instructions: Each post/taluka combination is a separate listing with its own vacancy count (mostly 1 post per taluka except where noted). Candidates must be within the 18-45 years age bracket on the date specified by the portal. Read the full job description on each post's own Details page, since duties differ by role (e.g., Farm Livelihood vs Non-Farm Livelihood vs MIS-focused posts). Applications must be submitted online only through the official portal; sign-in is required before applying. The listing for the Udupi District Manager post has an earlier closing date (07 Sep 2026) than the Haveri posts (11 Sep 2026) - do not miss this shorter window.
